snippet.title: Lelu - Release Date Trailer | Galaxies Autumn 2026 Showcase
snippet.description:
Find this game and every game from Galaxies Spring on our Steam Event page - https://store.steampowered.com/news/group/45348822/view/719040453611095010

Lelu is a small clockwork toy who has gained consciousness and has to escape a labyrinthine toy factory full of traps and towering clockwork titans. This monochrome action adventure by Jamie Rowan draws on Link's Awakening with faster, modern combat.
